blocks.html: There are 30 accessible Robinsons Malls Filipinos can go to in the remaining days of the voting registration. According to COMELEC, September 30 will be the last day of voting registration, thus, Filipinos are highly encouraged to settle their registrations in order to exercise their voting power on May 2022. This has been made possible by Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Centers.

Be informed and guided accordingly of Robinsons Malls registration site schedules. The following mall will be operational on September 25 only: Robinsons Cybergate Cebu and Robinsons Place Pavia. Robinsons Galleria’s voting registration site will be available for Quezon City District 3 Barangays on September 22 to 25, while for Pasig City District 1 residents, sites will be operational on dates September 24 and 25. Meanwhile, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Place Naga, and Robinsons Place Manila’s schedule is September 24, 25, and 27 to 30. Robinsons Otis will accommodate residents from District 6 barangays.

Moreover, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Galleria South, and Robinsons Place Valencia will be operational until September 30, every day. Robinsons Place GenSan will be open until September 30 except Saturday and Sunday. Robinsons Place Butuan will be operational as well until September 30, from Monday to Friday. Robinsons General Trias will be operational for voting registration on dates September 27, 29, and 30 and Robinsons Place Imus on September 24 and 27 to 30. Moreover, Robinsons Place Tagum’s schedule will be on September 28 to 30.

Robinsons Angeles and Robinsons Place Jaro are open for registration on dates September 24 and 25. Robinsons Place Santiago will be operational from September 27 to 29. The following registration sites will be open from September 27 to 30: Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons Place Palawan, and Robinsons Place Iloilo. Robinsons Place Roxas’ schedule are on dates September 22 to 28, 29, and 30 while Robinsons Magnolia on September 25, 27, and 28.

Schedules for Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, and Robinsons Forum are on dates September 25 and 27-30. Moreover, on September 23-25 and 27-30, Robinsons Place Pangasinan and Robinsons Starmills will be made available for the voting registration. Lastly, Robinsons Place Dumaguete’s registration site is scheduled on September 28, 29, and 30.
For more information about the available Robinsons Malls branches and their respective schedules, you may refer to https://sites.google.com/view/rmalls-lingkodpinoy/voter-registration.

Before going to registration sites, here are some important reminders: Make sure that you are bringing at least one (1) valid ID and have with you an accomplished voter registration form. Here are the accepted and valid IDs: Student ID, Employee’s ID, Postal ID, Senior Citizen’s ID, Driver’s License, Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) ID, NBI Clearance, Passport, SSS/GSIS ID, Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) ID, Professional Regular Commission (PRC) ID, and PWD ID. It is also important to know the invalid IDs; These are Cedula, Barangay Clearance, Barangay ID, Homeowners Association ID, QCitizen ID, Fraternity ID, and Police Clearance.

Downloadable voter registration form can be found at the COMELEC website: https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=VoterRegistration/ApplicationsForms or you can also fill it up online at http://irehistro.comelec.gov.ph.

Your vote can be the tie-breaker. Go to your nearest Robinsons Malls and don’t forget to bring your COVID-19 paraphernalia, face mask, face shield, and a black ballpen as Robinsons Malls strictly follow safety protocols.
